title: Website-Bot source-first reconstruction
objective: Make reconstruction the only path when a live source site exists: crawl must retain copy, phones, nav, photos, and CSS palette; downstream stages MUST port those observations and MUST fail closed instead of inventing a new brochure. Close remaining invention paths (generate-spec LLM identity and extra routes, content home-copy fallback, FAQ schema LLM, seo_contract.site_url pointing at igorbeylin.com). Land the campaign-local factory patches on Quantum-L9/Website-Bot. Preserve Safe Haven black plus Kyle blue plus white, real job photos, compact header, and (704) 648-7252. Reuse the campaign clone; do not rewrite already-working extract/design/chrome patches from origin/main.
success_criteria: When assets.sourceSite.enabled is true and crawled pages exist, ContentGenerationStage does not call generateContent; section text equals crawled headings plus bodyText for the matching slug only.
When assets.sourceSite.enabled is true and crawled pages are empty, ContentGenerationStage throws CONTENT_VALIDATION_FAILED and does not call generateContent.
When reconstructing, an unmatched route slug does not receive the home page body (no silent home-copy fallback).
When assets.sourceSite.enabled is true and crawled CSS has no palette, DesignIntelligenceStage throws DESIGN_REASONING_FAILED and does not call designReasoning.
PageExtractor emits phones from tel: hrefs as NANP display form and depth-1 header nav; SourceSiteIngestionStage refuses cache reuse when home page lacks bodyText or phones or nav.
ImageAssetPlanner assigns /logo.webp (or equivalent filename) to global:logo; OG 1200x630 cards are not the header wordmark.
Assembled siteConfig.nav is at most 8 depth-1 items from crawled header, siteConfig.phone is the crawled number, tokens.css primary is crawled hex (Safe Haven: #1ca0e0 background #000000).

When crawl pages exist, generate-spec DomainSpec.routes come from crawled pages (not the LLM service list); crawled phone and palette win; seo_contract.site_url is the showable Vercel alias until a custom-domain secret exists.
When reconstructing, SchemaGeneratorStage does not call generateSchema for FAQs; FAQPage entries come from the crawled FAQ page or the FAQ schema is omitted.

Safe Haven production alias https://safehavenrr-site.vercel.app shows source wordmark, compact nav, phone pill, unique job-photo heroes, gallery grid, and no markdown asterisks in H1 (hard-refresh the alias, not a stale dpl card).
Quantum-L9/Website-Bot PR contains the factory patches; Website-Bot make verify-all PASS.

stress_test.blast_radius: Wrong reconstruction ships an unshowable client site and trains the factory to invent brands. Invented extra routes plus home-copy fallback repeat the same essay on every page. A bad PR on Quantum-L9/Website-Bot changes every future consumer rebuild. A mistaken GoDaddy write is out of envelope. Regenerating Gemini heroes over real job photos burns budget and looks fake. A fake make pr-check gate stalls the PR for a target that does not exist.
stress_test.rollback: Revert the Website-Bot feature branch / close the PR; leave origin/main untouched. Do not force-push. Safe Haven Vercel alias can stay on the last known good production SHA. Do not revert GoDaddy (untouched). Do not delete the campaign clone or image cache.
